fields.topology_type: Point-to-point asymmetric (mostly source → sink with reverse direction Data Lane 0 in LP only). Host processor ↔ one peripheral (display module). Normatively the DSI v1.01.00 specification only addresses host-to-single-peripheral connections; multi-peripheral support via VC is mentioned (informative) but the wiring details are out of scope.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Command Mode
supported_topologies.description: Bidirectional Data Lane 0 + optional unidirectional Data Lanes 1..3; supports DCS read/write, Acknowledge and Error Report, Tearing Effect.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Video Mode unidirectional
supported_topologies.description: Cost-optimized; all Data Lanes unidirectional host → peripheral; no read-back, no Acknowledge / Error Report; the ECC capability still allows local single-bit error correction at the peripheral even though errors cannot be reported.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Video Mode bidirectional
supported_topologies.description: Data Lane 0 bidirectional for Acknowledge and Error Report and limited DCS commands; additional Data Lanes unidirectional.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-peripheral via VC (informative)
supported_topologies.description: Multiple peripherals share a common DSI Link using DI[7:6] VC[1:0]; details of multi-peripheral wiring beyond scope of DSI v1.01.00 normative spec; up to 4 logical streams.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives Clock Lane DDR unconditionally; sources all forward HS and LP transmissions; initiates BTA; programs T_INIT_MASTER at power-on; implements HTX_TO and LRX-H_TO contention-recovery timers.

Receives forward HS / LP transmissions; powers up in RX-Stop; after BTA from host, transmits Acknowledge / Error Report / Read Response / TE in LP on Data Lane 0; returns bus to host via its own BTA; bidirectional peripheral implements HRX_TO and LTX-P_TO; Command Mode peripheral has on-panel display controller + frame buffer; Video Mode peripheral may have only line buffer or none.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer router or hub. The link is a flat point-to-point pair (Clock Lane + N Data Lanes). VC-based multiplexing of multiple peripherals on a shared physical Link is informative; aggregation of multiple displays in real systems is typically done at the host SoC with multiple DSI master controllers, not on a shared Link.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_packet: Bytes transmitted byte-0 first; within each byte, LSB-first on the wire.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_transmission: Packets may be concatenated within a single HS transmission; when EoTp enabled the last packet is EoTp; HS Exit follows.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: Video Mode: VSS → VBP lines → VACT lines (HSS + HSA + HSE + HBP + RGB + HFP per line) → VFP lines → VSE (or just next VSS in Sync-Events / Burst modes).
ordering_guarantees.across_VCs: VCs interleave at packet boundary; no ordering between VCs.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: DSI itself has no addressable memory region on the wires. DCS commands (transported in DSI 0x05/0x15/0x06/0x39 packets) access the peripheral's on-panel registers and frame buffer per the MIPI DCS specification.

device_classification.host_processor: Application processor or baseband processor with embedded DSI master controller.
device_classification.peripheral_command_mode: Active-matrix display module with on-panel display controller, frame buffer, DCS interpreter, and bidirectional DSI slave interface.
device_classification.peripheral_video_mode: Active-matrix display module without on-panel frame buffer; relies on continuous host pixel stream.
device_classification.multi_peripheral_setup: Multiple driver ICs serving different areas of a common display panel, each tagged by a different VC[1:0]; informative.
